chunks: And they imagined that no trials would befall them; and they turned deaf and blind (to the truth). But God still turned to them; yet many of them turned blind and deaf again; but God sees everything they do.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God turns to people but they remain blind and deaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'idah highlights the progressive hardening of the heart, where initial complacency regarding divine retribution leads to a state of spiritual deafness and blindness. The repetition of 'then they became blind and deaf' underscores the cyclical nature of their deviation despite Allah's mercy, a concept often linked to the concept of *Tawbah* (repentance) followed by relapse. It serves as a warning that divine patience is not an absence of justice but a test of endurance, with Allah remaining the All-Seeing witness to their internal and external actions.
